text:
marta: quick q from ACME deal — they want an islanded installer we can drop on the floor (no egress). need: image shelf-life / delta update strategy / rollback story / packaging size limit and offline license pricing. need by EOD for SOW.

samir: we can produce offline bundles. size depends on model selection + artifacts. for a full LLM with weights expect ~40-200GB per model uncompressed; quantized builds are typically 8-40GB.

devon: runtime supports chunked/delta patching. recommended cadence: quarterly feature deltas, monthly security hotfixes, emergency hotfixes as needed. rollback via pointing installer to previous_bundle metadata and reapplying.

marta: do we provide signed bundles + SBOM for compliance?

samir: yes — we emit an SPDX SBOM and detached signatures. default: Redwood signs release blobs; customer can provide a public key for verification at install. if they require, we can re-sign with customer key under an approved SOW.

ara-security: question: can license/activation be bound to HSM or machine fingerprint? client asked about hardware-bound activation + offline attestation.

devon: we ship a signed license blob tied to tenant-id and optional machine-id. HSM-bound activation is supported as a custom integration (we've implemented for some on-prem customers). key point: offline activation requires no outbound call — install verifies signature locally.

samir: example offline install flow (for SOW):

```bash
# example offline install
tar -xzf bundle-tenant-123.tar.gz
./installer --accept-eula --license license.signed --verify-key customer_pub.pem
./installer apply-bundle --id tenant-123
```

marta: pricing ask from procurement — how to quote delta updates vs full image refresh?

samir: recommend line items: one-time base offline bundle + annual maintenance (covers quarterly deltas) + emergency patch retainer. simple framing: base = one-time fee, maintenance ~20% of hosted list ARR (negotiable), emergency retainer flat fee for out-of-band patches.

ben-legal: flag export controls and FIPS requirements. SBOM can be produced but redaction rules might apply. also need SLA language for offline deliveries and patch windows (X business days for normal, Y for critical).

marta: client wants upgrade window max 4 hours. feasible?

devon: with blue/green or dual-node topology we can hit near-zero user impact. single-node will likely need short downtime; we can reduce it by pre-warming KV cache and streaming shards. recommend we put a maintenance window in SOW and offer an optional prep run.

samir: ops-bot: build succeeded for offline-bundle/tenant-123 at 2798765440 (artifact: bundle-tenant-123-20260320.tar.gz) 

marta: perfect — I'll draft the SOW bullets: offline bundle (size ranges), cadence (quarterly + monthly hotfix), signing + SBOM, licensing model, pricing framing, upgrade expectations, optional HSM binding. any blockers?

ara-security: I'll draft the offline security Q&A template (signing verification steps, SBOM handling, KMS/HSM options, attestation language). will ping with a PR.

marta: thanks team — will send to sales lead and cc legal/security. :thumbsup:
